title: Discovering our neighbourhood
summary: Learn about neighbourhoods, villages and cities, and how to care for them.
keyIdeas: A municipality can include a small town or a large city.
The mayor and their team work at the town hall.
We all help care for parks, streets and neighbourhood services.

basicKnowledge: C. Sociedades y territorios › Alfabetización cívica
C. Sociedades y territorios › Conciencia ecosocial

activities.prompt: Which place has very tall buildings and busy avenues? 🏙️
activities.explanation: Large cities often have many residents, wide avenues and tall buildings.
activities.hint: Think of many cars and tall blocks with lifts.

activities.prompt: The town hall is the building where the mayor works.
activities.explanation: The municipality's government works in the town hall and organises local services.

activities.prompt: Match each need to the right neighbourhood place.
activities.explanation: Libraries, health centres and parks are local services and spaces. Not all are managed by the council.

activities.prompt: Choose the word that completes this road-safety rule.
activities.explanation: Use a pedestrian crossing with an adult. Look first and wait until it is safe.
activities.sentence: To cross the road safely, we use a ___ crossing.

activities.prompt: Sort these features by where they are more common.
activities.explanation: Small villages often have low houses and quiet streets. Some large cities have underground trains and tall towers.

items.text: Low houses and very quiet streets
Few residents who know each other

activities.prompt: Aisha walks her dog in the park. The dog poos on the grass. What should Aisha do? 🐕
activities.explanation: Dog owners must pick up their pet's poo to keep public places clean.
activities.hint: Think about children playing in the park.
options: Leave it because it is fertiliser
Cover it with leaves and run away
Pick it up with a bag and put it in a bin

activities.prompt: All residents should care for public benches and street lamps.
activities.explanation: Public street furniture belongs to the community. We treat it with care and respect.

activities.prompt: Put Lucas's steps for crossing at a pedestrian crossing with an adult in order.
activities.explanation: Use a pedestrian crossing with an adult, follow traffic lights and check that it is safe.
items: Stop before stepping off the pavement
Look both ways and check traffic lights if there are any
Wait until vehicles stop or no vehicles are coming
Walk across when it is safe

activities.prompt: Read this neighbourhood story and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Working together helps make public places pleasant and safe.
activities.title: A green day in the square
activities.text: Hugo's neighbourhood cares for its main square. On Saturday, the mayor and residents plant flowers. Hugo waters the pots with his grandmother. Now the square is clean and cheerful for everyone.

questions.prompt: Who helps Hugo water the pots?
questions.explanation: Hugo waters the pots with his grandmother.

questions.prompt: Why do the neighbours plant flowers together?
questions.explanation: They work together to make their shared neighbourhood nicer for everyone.
options: To care for and improve their shared space
To sell the pots and make money
Walking in the square is forbidden

activities.prompt: There are many traffic fumes in Martina's neighbourhood. Which action helps keep the air cleaner? 🚲
activities.explanation: Walking and cycling produce no exhaust fumes.
options: Sound the horn to warn other cars
Use a car for very short trips
